entities.summary: The Sayaji Rao Gaekwad Library, also known as the Central Library, is the main library of Banaras Hindu University (BHU) in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh in India. Established in 1917, it is listed in the Survey of Manuscripts in India. The present building of the library was built in 1941 on pattern of British Museum, at the suggestion of Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya, the founder of university, after his return from the Round Table Conference, London in 1931, with a donation from the Sayajirao Gaekwad III, Maharaja of Baroda State from 1875 to 1939, known for establishing libraries throughout his state.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Sayaji Rao Gaekwad Library played a significant role in the establishment of libraries throughout the Baroda State, with over 60 branches across the state. Its influence extended to the development of education and literacy in South Asia.
